turns.summary: Ride-hailing platform in Jakarta (ap-southeast-5) with data residency compliance. Kubernetes avoided; 8 microservices deployed on SAE across two zones. Cloud-native API Gateway and WAF handle ingress. Tair caches sessions/locations; RDS stores relational data. OSS for media, SLS for logs. Network includes VPC, NAT, ESA, and DNS. RocketMQ added in zones A/B for async trip events, replacing direct gateway calls to notification, fare, and rating services via new event connections. Flink and DataV added for real-time trip analytics dashboards, connected via MQ. Open questions: specific scaling policies per service, disaster recovery strategy beyond dual-zone, and integration details for payment providers.
